paragraphs.subTitle: Overview
paragraphs.content: KontenManager is your personal financial tool for managing bank accounts, tracking bookings, and — once a depot is enabled — monitoring a stock portfolio. Use the Home view for your daily bookings and the Company view to keep track of stock positions and depot value. All data stays stored locally in your browser.

paragraphs.subTitle: Getting Started
content: Create a new bank account via the header menu ('Add Bank Account').

Enable 'Depot Clearing Account' if you also want to manage stocks with this account — this automatically creates the 'Buy', 'Sell', and 'Dividend' booking types and unlocks the Company view for the account.
If you have existing data, use 'Import Database' to restore it, or 'Export Database' to create a backup.
The account selector in the title bar lets you switch between your accounts once more than one has been created.

paragraphs.subTitle: Managing Bookings
content: Add individual bookings for the selected account; use the three-dot menu at the end of each row to edit or delete an existing booking.
Categorize your transactions with your own 'booking types', for example for rent, salary, or fees.
Use the search field above the table to find bookings by date, remark, amount, or booking type.
The current account balance is always visible in the title bar on the Home view; the 'Yearly calculations' icon shows your booking results by booking type and year.

paragraphs.subTitle: Stocks & Portfolio
content: The Company view provides a specialized table for managing your stock positions; use the three-dot menu on each row to edit or delete a company, view dividends received, or open its external link.
Use 'Hide' in a company's edit dialog to remove it from the Company view without deleting its history; use 'Show company' in the header to bring it back.
The Info Bar at the top shows live market data, including exchange rates, indexes, and commodity prices.
In the Company view, the title bar displays the total value of your portfolio (Depot Sum).

paragraphs.subTitle: Settings & Personalization
content: Under 'Settings', choose one of six color themes (including Light, Dark, Ocean) and pick which service supplies quote and market data.
Further tabs manage the default currency for new accounts, plus the lists of market places, indexes, materials, and exchange rates shown in the Info Bar.
Configuration is stored locally in your browser and reloaded automatically when you open the extension.

paragraphs.subTitle: Accessibility
paragraphs.content: The interface is primarily designed for mouse and touch interaction. One exception is the Ctrl+Alt+R shortcut: after a confirmation prompt, it resets all of the extension's data — use it only if you really want to start over.

paragraphs.subTitle: Privacy First
paragraphs.content: Your privacy is important. Detailed information about data handling is available on our Privacy page, accessible from the footer.

paragraphs.subTitle: Local data
paragraphs.content: No data is sent to a server. Data is stored in an IndexedDB database. Only this add-on has access to the database. KontenManager does not personalize any data. Settings are stored in the browser's extension storage.

paragraphs.subTitle: Public data
paragraphs.content: KontenManager does not guarantee the accuracy of the data. When retrieving data, URIs including ISINs are sent over the Internet. Other data is not shared.

paragraphs.subTitle: Internet connections
paragraphs.content: Connections are established to download bank logo, exchange rate, stock price, min/max, index, and commodity data. Bank logos are looked up via Google's and DuckDuckGo's public favicon services, so the domain you type into the account form's search field — and your IP address — are visible to those providers.
